description:
GH: https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/kopitiam/issues/19

Point 1 of that issue — "bn cannot push to a non-local remote" — IS fixed, in
0.1.3 (commits f06e642, 653c22f: network push now delegates to the system `git`
binary; see crates/kopi-beans/src/git/gix_compat.rs:875-924). gix 0.86 still has
no send-pack (upstream #306), we just stopped pretending it does.

But the issue raised FOUR points and only the first is confirmed done. This bead
is to verify (or fix) the other three before closing GH#19:

2. TRANSACTIONALITY of `bn store migrate` w.r.t. the push. Original failure left
   the local ref migrated to v2 while `refs/remotes/origin/beads/store` stayed
   v1 — a half-state `bn` itself could not make progress from. `--no-push` now
   exists on the migrate args (cli_surface/commands/store.rs handle_migrate).
   QUESTION: with push now working, is the half-state still reachable when the
   push fails for some OTHER reason (no network, auth reject, non-fast-forward)?
   If yes, either don't advance the local ref, or complete locally and exit 0
   with the exact `git push origin refs/heads/beads/store` instruction.

3. VERSION AGGREGATION. Reporter: "bn aggregates the format version across
   several ref probes and reports the oldest", so a fully-migrated LOCAL ref got
   reported as v1 because the stale remote-tracking ref was older — and `bn
   status` then told the user to run the very migrate that had just half-
   succeeded. Loop with no exit except plain `git`. There IS test-shaped code
   around this at crates/kopi-beans/src/git/sync.rs:3282-3286, so it may already
   be handled. CONFIRM with an actual repro; don't assume.

4. DOCUMENT the gix push limitation prominently. It shaped the whole daemon
   auto-sync story, not just migration. Belongs in the crate rustdoc and
   ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS-adjacent notes, not buried at gix_compat.rs:875.

Do NOT close GH#19 until 2, 3 and 4 each have an answer backed by a real run.
title: kopi-beans: verify GH#19 leftovers — migrate/push transactionality and stale-remote-ref version aggregation
